error.command_start: Noctalia could not start the hotspot command.
error.missing_dependencies: start-hotspot, stop-hotspot and hotspot-status must be on PATH. Rebuild with the hotspot module enabled.
error.no_password: No password is set. Add one under [hotspot] in .env.local, set a password override in the plugin settings, or enable “Open network” to start without encryption.
error.no_uplink: {interface} is not connected to Wi-Fi. The access point borrows its channel, so connect first.
error.password_too_short: The hotspot password must be at least 8 characters.
error.ssid_too_long: The network name must be at most 32 characters.
error.state_mismatch: The requested hotspot state could not be confirmed.
error.status_parse: hotspot-status returned output Noctalia could not parse.
error.sudo_denied: Passwordless sudo for start-hotspot is not configured. Check the sudo rules in hotspot.nix.
